tools.name: reservio_get_business
tools.description: Get the business profile: name, address, contact details, time zone. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}.

tools.name: reservio_list_services
tools.description: List the services clients can book, with duration, price and capacity. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/services.

tools.name: reservio_get_service
tools.description: Get one service by id. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/services/{serviceId}.

tools.name: reservio_list_resources
tools.description: List bookable resources, such as staff members or rooms. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/resources.

tools.name: reservio_get_resource
tools.description: Get one resource (staff member or room) by id. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/resources/{resourceId}.

tools.name: reservio_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events (appointments, group events, blocked time) with start, end, type and capacity. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/events.

tools.name: reservio_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings with client name, state, cost and linked event. Sort by -createdAt to see the newest first (Reservio has no webhooks, so polling this is the way to find new bookings). Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/bookings.

tools.name: reservio_list_coupons
tools.description: List coupons (credit or visit packages). Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/coupons.

tools.name: reservio_get_coupon
tools.description: Get one coupon by id. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/coupons/{couponId}.

tools.name: reservio_list_opening_hours
tools.description: List the opening hours of the business (days and start/end in seconds from midnight). Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/opening-hours.

tools.name: reservio_list_rosters
tools.description: List staff work schedules (rosters) per resource and date. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/rosters.

tools.name: reservio_get_booking_slots
tools.description: List free time slots for a service in a date range, optionally for one resource. Use before creating a booking. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/availability/booking-slots.

tools.name: reservio_get_booking_days
tools.description: For each day in a range, tell whether any slot is free for a service. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/availability/booking-days.

tools.name: reservio_get_event_days
tools.description: For each day in a range, tell whether a group event is open for booking. Reservio API: GET /businesses/{businessId}/availability/event-days.

tools.name: reservio_create_appointment_booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a real appointment booking for a service at a start/end time (use a slot from reservio_get_booking_slots). Reservio may notify the client. Not safe to repeat: a second call books a second appointment. Reservio API: POST /businesses/{businessId}/bookings.

tools.name: reservio_create_group_booking
tools.description: WRITE: book a client into an existing group event (event id from reservio_list_events). Reservio may notify the client. Not safe to repeat: a second call books a second seat. Reservio API: POST /businesses/{businessId}/bookings.
